title: RAID EVENTS ARE EVENT ALERTS
why: His answer of 2026-10-14: he did not know what tonight raid events were, so he never noticed them, and each event start needs a clear alert with its name and one short detail. The events already said their name and a detail in the alert lane, as one more red triangle for three and a half seconds. Each event alert (orbital debris, machine convoy, bounty pillager, coolant rupture, Overseer rampage, the stronghold gate and doors, the fuel fires, the air strike) now wears the diamond of its mark on the map and holds the lane for five seconds. The words are the event own; only how the lane shows them changed.
now: Raid event alerts now wear the diamond glyph of their map mark and hold the lane for five seconds.
